assumptions.obligation: While i_rst_n_core is low, the AHB manager drives HSEL=0, HTRANS=IDLE, HWRITE=0, HBURST=SINGLE and HMASTLOCK=0.
The AXI Subordinate is reset together with the bridge and keeps BVALID and RVALID low during reset.

During a data phase owned by this Subordinate, the global HREADY equals this Subordinate's HREADYOUT, as set by the AHB5 HREADY multiplexor. Outside such a phase, and during reset, HREADY is left unconstrained.
The manager holds HWDATA/HWSTRB stable while a write data phase to this Subordinate is extended by HREADY=0.
HTRANS=SEQ or BUSY is presented to this Subordinate only inside a non-SINGLE burst. The first beat of a burst is NONSEQ.
The AXI Subordinate asserts BVALID only after both the AW handshake and the WLAST W handshake of an outstanding write have completed.
Once BVALID is asserted, BVALID, BID and BRESP stay stable until BREADY.
BID equals the AWID of the outstanding write. This is enforced only while exactly one write is outstanding and its ID is known.
The AXI Subordinate asserts RVALID only after the AR handshake of an outstanding read.
Once RVALID is asserted, RVALID, RID, RDATA, RRESP and RLAST stay stable until RREADY.
RID equals the ARID of the outstanding read. This is enforced only while exactly one read is outstanding and its ID is known.
Every R beat carries RLAST=1, because every read is single-beat (ARLEN=0).
